title: 第7章 季前赛训练营第8章 弱爆了
content_zh:
第七章 季前赛训练营
听到“王尔德”这个姓氏，叶锋想起加布瑞拉是谁了。她在2011年底出演了好莱坞商业大片《三个火枪手》，被评为最美丽的“花瓶”。这部电影相当YY，让飞艇早出现了几百年，上演了一场空中大战，就像飞天版的加勒比海盗。由于评价一般，叶锋没看这部电影，只在海报上看到过加布瑞拉的剧照。
加布瑞拉的演艺生涯并不顺利，2011年才拍了这第一部电影。没想到2007年她已经来到了美国。
叶锋问道：“你是来闯荡好莱坞的吧？”
加布瑞拉微笑道：“是啊。你怎么知道？”
“因为你很漂亮，看上去就像明星。”叶锋笑道，这并不是恭维。
“谢谢。”
“祝你早日成名，我去练球了。拜拜，希曼。”叶锋也朝尼尔招了招手。尼尔为了展现自己的强壮，今天穿了紧身背心，还穿了条七分裤，配上他的发型，确实有点像漫画《宇宙巨人》里的希曼。
加布瑞拉看了哥哥一眼，哈哈大笑。尼尔无奈了，不过看两人相处的挺融洽，他也稍微安心了一些。
半个月后，尼尔终于放心了。叶锋的心思几乎全放在了篮球上。他每天都是一早就出门，训练到很晚才回家，洗完澡就休息。他和加布瑞拉根本说不了几句话，互不干涉对方的生活。
拜纳姆在8月底结束了训练。叶锋获得批准继续使用训练场，每天练习运球和投篮。距离训练营越来越近，他必须抓紧时间练好基本功。虽然拉芙林、扎萨纳等人看好他，但他也知道自己的劣势，那就是从没打过全场比赛，没有半点比赛经验。一个没有比赛经验的人只靠身体素质就能干败千挑万选的NBA球员，那恐怕只会出现在梦里。他的目标是在进攻端不丢人的情况下全力做好防守工作，在湖人阵中占据一席之地。
2007年9月18日，湖人队官方网站公布了2007－2008赛季训练营日程，24日举办“媒体日”活动，25日周三下午举行首次公开训练课，球迷们可以到场观战，并参加一系列联谊活动。
湖人的季前赛训练营的十八人大名单浮出了水面。
组织后卫：德里克.费舍尔、乔丹.法玛尔、加瓦里斯.克里坦顿。
得分后卫：科比.布莱恩特、莫里斯.埃文斯、萨沙.武贾西奇、库比.卡尔。
小前锋：卢克·沃顿、弗拉迪米尔.拉德马诺维奇。
大前锋：拉玛尔.奥多姆、罗尼.图里亚夫，布莱恩.库克、艾尔顿.布朗，叶锋。
中锋：安德鲁.拜纳姆、夸梅.布朗、克里斯.米姆、拉里.特纳。
湖人总经理库普切克明确表示今年不会与孙悦签约，下赛季或许会利用优先权签下他。NBA的第一轮新秀和第二轮新秀，最大的区别就在于选中二轮新秀的球队可以“拥有”这名球员三年，但球队不一定要和他们签约，比如湖人今年在第48位选中的马克.加索尔，下赛季就将继在欧洲打球。此外，球队还可以选择与第二轮新秀签订非保障性合同，这意味着球队随时可以和球员解约，不必承担任何违约责任。
没有了孙悦，叶锋更受关注，不过专家们普遍认为他的前景并不乐观。常规赛开始的时候，湖人只会保留十五人的轮换阵容，至少三人会被裁掉。NBA的规定常规赛每只球队注册球员只能有15人，每场比赛允许上场的激活球员只能有12人，有部分没有伤的球员会在伤病名单里面等待机会。

湖人队的内线球员太多，四名中锋，五名大前锋，抛开二当家奥多姆，叶锋要和三人竞争以求获得出场时间。看这三人的履历，都比他强的多。
湖人刚刚3年1050万续约的布莱恩.库克，身高206CM，体重112公斤，看起来很壮实，其实打球很软。他是喜欢投三分的另类大前锋，畏惧对抗，和队友挡拆后就在外线寻找出手机会，防守和篮板都不是强项，上赛季他为湖人出场65次，24次首发，15.7分钟得到6.9分3.3篮板1助攻，三分球命中率高达40%，进攻效率很高。
罗尼.图里亚夫，身高208CM，体重111公斤，肌**子一名，上赛季代表湖人打了72场比赛，15.1分钟5.3分3.6篮板1助攻1.1盖帽，是不错的防守蓝领。
艾尔顿.布朗，身高206CM，体重114公斤，没有NBA经验，上赛季他效力于NBDL的科罗拉多14人队，场均拿到18.4分9.6个篮板2.2盖帽，场均接近两双，是NBDL表现最好的球员之一。
叶锋压根没任何数据，所以他是最神秘的人，也是最有可能被裁掉的。
25日，湖人球员们都来到了训练馆亮相，馆内早早的坐满了观众，虽然在奥尼尔离去后，他们最好的成绩只是季后赛第一轮，但有科比.布莱恩特这位超级得分手在，就能吸引大量球迷，有的球迷根本不在乎胜负，就喜欢看球星彪分。
叶锋领到了74号球衣，拉芙林说这是管理层对他的鼓励，在联盟里从来没人用过74号，他是独一无二的！叶锋更想要球星穿的号码，比如23号、34号，他不明白没人用过的号码算什么鼓励。
同样是新赛季前的训练营，不同类型球员的态度截然不同。老将、新秀和伤愈复出的球员都带着不同的心情赶到了本队训练营。叶锋最紧张。这是他第一次参加训练营，他不知道一切到底会是什么样子，他不知道自己能不能适应一支NBA球队的训练。
拜纳姆和法玛尔一起给叶锋支招，告诫他不要浪投，防守要积极，严格执行教练安排的战术，只有认真做到这三点，才可能留下。知道加布瑞拉和叶锋成了室友后，法玛尔和他关系变的很近，有空就去他家串门。
叶锋早拿定主意，进攻会尽量用扣篮来完成，绝不展现自己低劣的跳投技术。
科比到场后，和众人一一打了招呼，一个夏天人们都在讨论他的转会问题，现在看他的心情不错，面带微笑。他朝叶锋走过来，主动打了招呼：“你好，叶锋，我听说过你，也看了你的体侧数据，希望你在篮球场上也能成为一个让人害怕的狠角色，好好打。”
“谢谢，我会努力的。”
两人握了握手。科比主动说话，叶锋有种受宠若惊的感觉，毕竟对方是联盟中最好的球员之一。媒体经常说科比情商低，和队友搞不好关系。第一次见面，叶锋感觉还不错。他问身边的两人：“科比看起来很好说话，平时都这样吗？”
法玛尔轻道：“只要不输球，他的脾气就很好。上赛季我刚被湖人选中的时候，他还给我打过电话鼓励我呢。如果你想让他一直看你顺眼，就要好好打，不能拖球队的后腿。”
叶锋点了点头。
科比是个求胜欲望超强的人。作为联盟巨星，他的斗志是最让球迷所欣赏的。因为球队战绩太差，这个夏天科比在接受ESPN电视台采访时明确表示想要离队，消息一经曝光，引起了美国媒体的各种猜测，科比透露最想去的球队其中两家是芝加哥公牛和纽约尼克斯。不过主教练菲尔.杰克逊很快就让他放弃了这一念头，老板杰里.巴斯也承诺湖人将会有大交易，稳住了他的情绪。
人还没到齐，科比就开始练习投篮。拜纳姆说科比即使训练也很卖力，哪怕只是一场练习赛，他都不想别人赢。他是在找手感，打对抗赛的时候发威。科比投篮一次次命中，在场的观众们纷纷朝他招手呐喊。叶锋很羡慕，真希望自己也能人气这么高。
等球员们集合完毕，湖人副总裁珍妮.巴斯站到了场地中央，拿起麦克风，对新赛季做了一番展望。老板杰里.巴斯已经年过七旬，他对经营球队有些力不从心，女儿珍妮和次子吉姆很有可能近几年接他的班。
珍妮微笑道：“各位来宾，亲爱的球迷们。欢迎你们到场观看湖人新赛季第一场训练课，我是珍妮.巴斯。在最近一项洛杉矶球队民意调查中，有87%的球迷投票说愿意观看湖人的比赛，只有13%的愿意关注快船队，我在这里要感谢大家的支持。有人评价说湖人抠门，连续几个赛季都没有引进大牌球员。实际上我们只是没有合适的目标，现在不同了，我可以保证，这赛季湖人就能崛起，三年内冲击总冠军！”
观众们热烈的鼓掌。

叶锋心中疑惑，好像湖人现在就开始策划和灰熊的交易了，如果不是有十足的把握，不会说的这么自信。前世那笔交易说是黑幕也不过分。灰熊送出了核心保罗.加索尔和2010年第二轮选秀权，换回来了水货状元夸梅.布朗，退役的阿隆.麦基，还没打过NBA的二轮新秀马克.加索尔，以及湖人2008年的首轮选秀权和2010年首轮选秀权。这哪里是交易？分明是赠送球星，外加帮湖人处理垃圾合同。如果不是后来马克.加索尔意外的发挥出色，这笔交易对灰熊来说近乎一无所获。
听到这样的保证，叶锋更要争取留在湖人。

Chapter 7 Preseason Training Camp
Hearing the surname "Wilde", Ye Feng remembered who Gabriella was. She starred in the Hollywood commercial blockbuster "The Three Musketeers" at the end of 2011 and was named the most beautiful "vase". This movie is quite YY, making airships appear hundreds of years earlier, and staged an aerial battle, just like a flying version of Pirates of the Caribbean. Due to the mediocre reviews, Ye Feng did not watch the movie and only saw the stills of Gabriella on the poster.
Gabriella's acting career was not smooth, and she only made her first movie in 2011. Unexpectedly, she came to the United States in 2007.
Ye Feng asked: "Are you here to make a career in Hollywood?"
Gabriella smiled and said, "Yes. How do you know?"
"Because you are very beautiful and look like a star." Ye Feng said with a smile. This was not a compliment.
"Thank you."
"I wish you become famous soon. I'm going to practice football. Bye, Seaman." Ye Feng also waved to Neil. In order to show his strength, Neil wore a tight-fitting vest and a pair of cropped pants today. With his hairstyle, he does look a bit like He-Man in the comic "Cosmic Titans".
Gabriella glanced at her brother and laughed. Neil was helpless, but seeing that the two of them got along well, he felt a little more at ease.
Half a month later, Neil finally felt relieved. Ye Feng's mind is almost entirely focused on basketball. He goes out early every day, trains until very late, then comes home, and rests after taking a shower. He and Gabriella couldn't say a few words at all, and they didn't interfere in each other's lives.
Bynum ended training at the end of August. Ye Feng was approved to continue using the training ground and practice dribbling and shooting every day. As training camp is getting closer, he must seize the time to practice his basic skills. Although Laughlin, Zasana and others are optimistic about him, he also knows his disadvantages, which is that he has never played a full game and has no game experience. A person with no game experience who can defeat thousands of NBA players relying solely on physical fitness may only appear in his dreams. His goal is to do a good job on defense without being embarrassed on the offensive end and occupy a place in the Lakers' lineup.
On September 18, 2007, the Lakers' official website announced the 2007-2008 season training camp schedule. A "Media Day" event was held on the 24th, and the first public training session was held on the afternoon of Wednesday the 25th. Fans could attend the game and participate in a series of social activities.
The 18-man roster for the Lakers' preseason training camp has surfaced.
Point guards: Derek Fisher, Jordan Farmar, Gavaris Crittenton.
Shooting guards: Kobe Bryant, Maurice Evans, Sasha Vujacic, Kuby Carr.
Small forwards: Luke Walton, Vladimir Radmanovic.
Power forward: Lamar Odom, Ronny Turiaf, Brian Cook, Elton Brown, Ye Feng.
Center: Andrew Bynum, Kwame Brown, Chris Mihm, Larry Turner.
Lakers general manager Kupchak made it clear that he will not sign Sun Yue this year and may use priority to sign him next season. The biggest difference between NBA first-round picks and second-round picks is that the team that selects the second-round pick can "own" the player for three years, but the team does not have to sign with them. For example, Marc Gasol, selected by the Lakers with the 48th pick this year, will continue to play in Europe next season. In addition, the team can also choose to sign a non-guaranteed contract with the second-round pick, which means that the team can terminate the player's contract at any time without assuming any liability for breach of contract.
Without Sun Yue, Ye Feng has attracted more attention, but experts generally believe that his prospects are not optimistic. At the start of the regular season, the Lakers will only retain a fifteen-man rotation, and at least three will be waived. NBA rules for each regular seasonThere are only 15 registered players in the team, and only 12 activated players are allowed to play in each game. Some players who are not injured will wait for opportunities on the injury list.
The Lakers have too many inside players, four centers and five power forwards. Putting aside the second-in-command Odom, Ye Feng has to compete with the three for playing time. Looking at the resumes of these three people, they are all much better than him.
Brian Cook, who has just been renewed by the Lakers for 10.5 million for three years, is 206cm tall and weighs 112kg. He looks very strong, but in fact he plays very softly. He is an alternative power forward who likes to shoot three-pointers. He is afraid of confrontation. After picking and rolling with his teammates, he looks for shooting opportunities on the outside. Defense and rebounding are not strong points. He played 65 times for the Lakers last season, starting 24 times. He scored 6.9 points, 3.3 rebounds and 1 assist in 15.7 minutes. His three-point shooting rate was as high as 40%, and his offensive efficiency was very high.
Ronny Turiaf, 208cm tall, weighs 111kg, is a muscular player. He played 72 games for the Lakers last season, averaging 5.3 points, 3.6 rebounds, 1 assist and 1.1 blocks in 15.1 minutes. He is a good defensive blue-collar player.
Elton Brown, 206cm tall, 114kg in weight, has no NBA experience. Last season he played for the Colorado 14ers of the NBDL, averaging 18.4 points, 9.6 rebounds and 2.2 blocks per game, averaging close to a double-double. He was one of the best players in the NBDL.
Ye Feng has no data at all, so he is the most mysterious person and the most likely to be laid off.
On the 25th, all the Lakers players came to the training hall, and the hall was filled with spectators early. Although their best result after O'Neal left was the first round of the playoffs, with Kobe Bryant, the super scorer, they can attract a large number of fans. Some fans don't care about winning or losing at all, they just like to watch the star score.
Ye Feng received the No. 74 jersey. Laughlin said that this was the encouragement from the management. No one in the league has ever used No. 74. He is unique! Ye Feng prefers numbers worn by stars, such as No. 23 and No. 34. He doesn't understand what encouragement a number that no one has used is considered.
It is also the training camp before the new season, and different types of players have completely different attitudes. Veterans, rookies and players returning from injury all arrived at the team's training camp with different moods. Ye Feng was the most nervous. This is his first training camp, and he doesn't know what everything will be like. He doesn't know if he can adapt to the training of an NBA team.
Bynum and Farmar gave Ye Feng advice together, warning him not to waste shots, to be active in defense, and to strictly implement the tactics arranged by the coach. Only by conscientiously doing these three things can he stay. After learning that Gabriella and Ye Feng had become roommates, Farmar became very close to him and would visit his house when he had time.
Ye Feng had already made up his mind that he would try his best to complete the offense with dunks and never show off his inferior jump shooting skills.
After Kobe arrived, he greeted everyone one by one. People had been discussing his transfer issue all summer. Now he seems to be in a good mood and smiling. He walked towards Ye Feng and took the initiative to say hello: "Hello, Ye Feng, I've heard about you and seen your body statistics. I hope you can become a fearsome and ruthless character on the basketball court. Play well."
"Thank you, I will try my best."
The two shook hands. Kobe took the initiative to speak, and Ye Feng felt flattered. After all, the opponent was one of the best players in the league. The media often says that Kobe has low emotional intelligence and has poor relationships with his teammates. The first time they met, Ye Feng felt pretty good. He asked the two people around him: "Kobe seems to be very talkative. Is he always like this?"
Farmar said lightly: "As long as he doesn't lose, he has a good temper. When I was first selected by the Lakers last season, he even called me to encourage me.If you want him to always like you, you have to play hard and not hold the team back. "
Ye Feng nodded.
Kobe is a man with a strong desire to win. As a league superstar, his fighting spirit is what fans appreciate the most. Because the team's record was so poor, Kobe made it clear in an interview with ESPN this summer that he wanted to leave the team. Once the news was exposed, it caused various speculations in the American media. Kobe revealed that the two teams he wanted to go to the most were the Chicago Bulls and the New York Knicks. However, head coach Phil Jackson quickly asked him to give up this idea, and owner Jerry Buss also promised that the Lakers would have a big deal, which stabilized his emotions.
Before everyone arrived, Kobe started practicing shooting. Bynum said that Kobe worked very hard even in training. Even if it was just a practice game, he didn't want others to win. He is looking for touch and shows off his power in the competition. Kobe hit the shot again and again, and the audience waved and shouted at him. Ye Feng was very envious and really wished he could be so popular.
After the players were assembled, Lakers Vice President Jenny Buss stood in the center of the field, picked up the microphone, and made some prospects for the new season. Owner Jerry Buss is over 70 years old and he is somewhat unable to manage the team. His daughter Jenny and second son Jim are likely to take over from him in recent years.
Jenny smiled and said: “Dear guests, dear fans. Welcome to the Lakers' first training session of the new season. My name is Jenny Buss. In a recent Los Angeles team poll, 87% of fans voted that they were willing to watch the Lakers, and only 13% were willing to follow the Clippers. I would like to thank everyone for their support. Some people commented that the Lakers are stingy and have not introduced big-name players for several consecutive seasons. In fact, we just don't have a suitable goal. It's different now. I can guarantee that the Lakers will rise this season and hit the championship within three years! "
The audience applauded enthusiastically.
Ye Feng was confused. It seemed that the Lakers were planning a deal with the Grizzlies now. If he wasn't completely sure, he wouldn't be so confident. It would not be an exaggeration to say that the transaction in the previous life was a shady affair. The Grizzlies sent core Pau Gasol and the 2010 second-round pick in exchange for parallel import No. 1 pick Kwame Brown, the retired Aaron McGee, second-round pick Marc Gasol who has not played in the NBA, and the Lakers' 2008 first-round pick and 2010 first-round pick. Where is the deal? It's obviously a gift to the stars, plus helping the Lakers deal with junk contracts. If it weren't for Marc Gasol's unexpected performance later, this deal would have resulted in almost nothing for the Grizzlies.
After hearing such a guarantee, Ye Feng was even more determined to stay in the Lakers.
